title: My dream location
content: I’ve been coming to this same cove in my dreams since high school. It was my favorite place to go as a kid. After my last night terror in 2005, I looked up how to help stop them and lucid dreaming came up. I gave it a shot and since then, 90% of my dreams take place here. The lucid dreaming aspect isn’t always present but I’m always so happy to come back to my favorite place.
